question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**than**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the deltaic regions of India.
 
• In the second filler, '**than**' should be used because after **comparative degree (wider)** we should use '**than**' conjunction.
 
• It is used when you are comparing two things. (दो वस्‍तुओं की तुलना के लिए प्रयुक्त से, की अपेक्षा)
 
 
• *Example: He’s** taller than **me.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__* The predominantly deltaic eastern coastal plain is an area of deep sedimentation. Over __most__ (1) of its length it is considerably wider __**than**__** (2)** the plain on the western coast. (3)________ major deltas, from south to north, (4) _______ of the Kaveri, the Krishna-Godavari, the Mahanadi, and the Ganges-Brahmaputra rivers. The last of (5)________ is some 190 miles (300 km) wide, but only about one-third of it lies within India.*

The correct answer is 'The</strong&
